notes: Men's teams only. Excluded per request: all women's teams/leagues, and special squads (Soccer Aid, adidas All-Star, MLS All-Star, Zlatan FC, Classic XI, Icons, Free Agents, AFC Richmond).

Liga MX, K League 2 and Botola Pro are NOT in FC 26 - they are FC 27 additions (Liga MX return officially slated for FC 27 per June 2026 reporting). Some fan pages list them alongside FC 26 as upcoming content.
Unlicensed clubs use their in-game names: Serie A shows Bergamo Calcio (=Atalanta), Lombardia FC (=Inter), Latium (=Lazio), Milano FC (=AC Milan).

CONMEBOL Libertadores/Sudamericana lists reflect the 2026 tournament editions (current post-update database); those clubs are playable in Kick Off/Tournament modes. Argentine clubs appear only under Liga Profesional de Futbol (no duplicates across the three groups).

Indian Super League: current database has 14 teams, including SC Delhi (rebranded Hyderabad FC), Odisha FC and United Tigers SC added via update; the launch database had 12. This league is the least certain.

National teams: 60 men's teams after the World's Game Update (May/June 2026): 51 fully licensed + 9 with generic kits (Algeria, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Congo DR, Curacao, Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Japan, Jordan; Bosnia and Congo DR became licensed June 4, 2026). All 60 are playable.
A-League Men has 12 clubs (Western United was removed from the real-world league before FC 26 launched).
